page_new.excerpt: # Request-Reply Messaging **Decision.** Use messaging Request-Reply when a request and its reply travel as separate messages on separate channels and the requestor can wait or handle a callback. In the Synchronous Block case, the request thread waits for the reply, which implies one outstanding request or a reply channel private to the requesting thread. In the Asynchronous Callback case, the source states: "This approach enables multiple outstanding requests to share a single reply channel, and a single reply thread to process replies for multiple request threads."
